text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaah—...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for the Takarazuka Kinen
are finally in the home stretch—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what was the lap time?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hao! Looking great.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Right. I went back over the materials on our opponents
and noticed something new."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to go over our strategy
for the day of the race once more, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown and her Trainer...
As clever as ever in their exchanges, I see.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The meticulous and ingenious formulation of the strategy, paired with Crown's finesse in executing it...
Truly worthy of being the top contender for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's too early to call a frontrunner.
After all, at Takarazuka—!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —GAAAAAHHH...!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Whew! As intense as ever... No, you've polished those powerhouse legs of yours even further, Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, she possesses an aura truly befitting
a Grand Prix champion..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Crown and Duramente...
As for the girl hitting her stride so as not to be outdone by these two brilliant elites—!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Gwaaaaahhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*...! *cough*...
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh, just, one more...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, hold on... That's terrifying.
Just how many uphill runs has that been...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know. ...I mean, she was already running
before we even got here, right?
Even though we've been covering her for two hours now..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I'd heard that Kitasan Black's main strength was her durability, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To think she could push herself that far.
It's quite... beyond common sense.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Still, this generation's really turning out to be packed with monsters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown, an ultra-elite from the very start, and
Duramente, who magnificently proved the greatness
of her bloodline and natural talent...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, Kitasan Black has been improving by leaps and bounds, joining the fray... Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Leading the current racing world—there's no doubt those girls are the center of this era.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A generation... filled with monsters.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Who stands at the center of this era is already decided.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Then what if...
What if that isn't the case?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"If it hadn't been now.
If it hadn't been those girls.
...Then, I would have..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Was I... a little better than before?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Losing and losing, getting left behind.
I'm not just gonna stay buried in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Did I get... at least a little closer
to who I want to be?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Alright, update complete. With this, the strategy for the day of the Takarazuka Kinen is—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, Crown-san—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wah!! S-Sorry, I didn't look!
I-I didn't see what was inside, I swear...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha!
Don't worry about it so much, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind if they look closely at all.
I'll figure out a way to handle it either way!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I, see.
...Crown-san really is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I-I didn't look at the details, but...
Even at a glance, I could tell right away...
that it was an incredibly meticulous document.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This is how I race.
Think, formulate, and prepare.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I looked into Duramente-san and
Kita-san as much as I could as rivals, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Of course, that includes you too, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? But aren't you running in
the Takarazuka Kinen as well?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You put on quite an impressive run in the Tenno Sho (Spring) the other day.
It's astonishing to think that was your very first GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "You're probably suited for long distances, so the 2,200m Takarazuka might be a bit tough on you, but—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm not letting my guard down.
I'm going to beat everyone and take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Even against you,
I won't lose, Cheval."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, at last—
the day of the Takarazuka Kinen had arrived!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—No problem.
Alright, that finishes the final check!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, the presence of her rivals is terrifying.
On top of Duramente, who already has her sights set on the world, Kitasan Black's conditioning is eerily impressive too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—even so, I have no intention of hanging my head.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And that will inevitably
lead to results.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I will definitely make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of losing to anyone.
Because I'm going to become the Umamusume
who makes the Satono name echo across the world!
